stories.title: FalconX and Interstice Link Canton Network to Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood Chain
stories.summary: FalconX and Interstice built connections between the Canton Network and Ethereum, Solana, and Robinhood's chain. The links let assets and data move across these networks instead of staying locked on Canton alone.
stories.whyItMatters: Links between institutional chains like Canton and major public or retail chains support wider use of tokenized assets and deeper liquidity.
whatToWatch: Which institutions or assets use the new links first
Whether more chains get added to the connection
questions: How is custody and security handled across the connected chains?
How much volume moves through the new links at launch?

stories.title: Ethereum's Next Upgrade Aims to Hide Trades From Bots and Rewrites Gas Rules
stories.summary: Ethereum's next upgrade will try to hide pending trades from bots so they cannot front-run traders. The upgrade also changes the flat 21,000-gas cost that wallets have long used for simple transfers.
stories.whyItMatters: The gas-cost change and the anti-bot measure touch every wallet and app on Ethereum, and could shift both fees and bot behavior.
whatToWatch: The upgrade's confirmed name and activation date
How wallet developers update their gas-estimation code
Whether bot front-running activity drops after launch
questions: What replaces the old 21,000-gas assumption?
Does the anti-front-running design also block legitimate arbitrage activity?

stories.title: Neuberger Berman Partners With Securitize on Multi-Chain Tokenized Bond Fund
stories.summary: Asset manager Neuberger Berman is working with tokenization platform Securitize to launch a tokenized fixed-income fund. The fund will run across multiple blockchains.
stories.whyItMatters: A large traditional asset manager moving fixed-income products on-chain adds weight to the growing tokenized bond and treasury market.
whatToWatch: The fund's launch date and supported chains
The fund's initial size and who can invest
questions: Which specific chains will the fund support?
Is the fund open to retail investors or institutions only?

stories.title: Bitcoin Miners' AI Pivot Pays Off, but Mining Could Make a Comeback
stories.summary: Bitcoin miners that added AI data-center hosting are seeing that bet pay off. At the same time, a widening strain in the energy market is raising fresh questions about power costs, and some see a shift that could make mining itself attractive again. Bitcoin traded near $64,000 as the broader market slipped.
stories.whyItMatters: Miner economics affect network security and hash rate, and the AI pivot has changed how mining firms make money beyond block rewards.
whatToWatch: New AI-hosting deals from mining companies
How energy-market stress affects miner power costs
Bitcoin's price action near the $64,000 level
questions: What specific change could revive mining economics?
How exposed are miners to further energy-price swings?

stories.title: SEC Proposes Its First Major Crypto Rule in a Surprise Move
stories.summary: The SEC proposed what is described as its first major crypto-specific rule. The announcement came without prior warning, and the rule's exact scope is not yet clear.
stories.whyItMatters: A first formal SEC crypto rule would mark a significant step in how the agency plans to regulate digital assets.
whatToWatch: Publication of the full rule text
The public comment period and industry reaction
questions: What does the rule actually cover?
Why did the SEC announce it now, without notice?

stories.title: Wyoming Joins $15 Billion Exodus From LayerZero With State Stablecoin Move
stories.summary: Wyoming is moving its state-backed stablecoin project away from LayerZero. The state joins what is described as a $15 billion exodus from the interoperability protocol.
stories.whyItMatters: Wyoming's stablecoin is a closely watched test case for government-backed stablecoins, so its infrastructure choice signals what other states may do.
whatToWatch: Which protocol Wyoming moves to instead
Whether other LayerZero users follow
The timeline for Wyoming's stablecoin launch
questions: What prompted the move away from LayerZero?
Is this driven by cost, security, or performance concerns?

stories.whyItMatters: Cash App has a large retail user base, so wider asset support there can meaningfully expand mainstream crypto access.

stories.title: Bitcoin Goes Quiet as Traders Chase Bigger Payoffs Elsewhere
stories.summary: Bitcoin's volatility has cooled, and some traders are reportedly rotating into other assets in search of "5x or 10x" gains. Still, bitcoin scored a rare win over stocks, rising 2.6% while the S&P 500 fell 0.5%.
stories.whyItMatters: Lower bitcoin volatility alongside capital rotation into riskier bets is worth tracking, even though bitcoin's outperformance versus equities complicates a simple "bitcoin is boring" read.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin's low volatility continues
Where the rotating capital is flowing
Bitcoin's performance against equities going forward
questions: What exactly is drawing traders toward "5x or 10x" bets?
Is this rotation coming out of bitcoin, or is it new capital bypassing it?

stories.whyItMatters: Metaplanet has been a bellwether for corporate bitcoin treasury adoption, so its US move could draw more Nasdaq-listed firms toward the same strategy.

Whether Metaplanet adds to its bitcoin holdings further

stories.title: SEC Proposes Crypto Rulebook as Clarity Act Stalls in Congress
stories.summary: The SEC put forward a proposed crypto rulebook while the Clarity Act, a crypto market-structure bill, remains stalled in Congress. The agency's move suggests it will not wait for legislation to act.
stories.whyItMatters: With Congress stalled on crypto market-structure law, SEC rulemaking could become the framework the industry has to work with in the meantime.

questions: Does the SEC rulebook overlap or conflict with the stalled Clarity Act?
